name: tablekit
description: Glue and instrumentation for a live tabletop game where some seats are AI agents. Produces one append-only JSONL per session that is simultaneously the play ledger (dmcheck-compatible) and a four-lane telemetry stream: qa (did the machinery work), qc (was the refereeing correct), ux (what the seat's evening looked like), uxr (how it felt from a seat, elicited from players as one-token markers). Plus outcome pairs that record whether a craft move actually worked.

subcommands.init [path]: Write a starter table.json. Exit 2 if the file exists.
subcommands.markers: Print the player marker card to paste at the table.
subcommands.beat \"<text>\" [--cue SEAT] [--chunks N: Record a GM beat; opens a cue pair and checks the cue is deliverable. Exit 1 if the cue would be dropped in transit.
subcommands.inbound --seat S --text \"...\": Record what a seat said; extracts UXR markers, closes matching cue/checkin pairs.
subcommands.consumed <pair-id> [--outcome ...]: Close a pair. Exit 2 if the id is not open.
subcommands.checkin --seat S: Record checking on a quiet seat; closes when they next speak.
subcommands.turn --seat S [--wait N]: Record that a seat got the floor.
subcommands.qc [--state FILE] [--record] [--json]: Run the checks. Exit 1 if there are findings.
subcommands.sweep: Close pairs past their TTL with named outcomes. Exit 1 if any expired.
subcommands.report [--json] [--out FILE]: Post-session report. Exit 0 clean, 1 defects, 2 not enough data.
subcommands.schema: Event schema, pair kinds, marker vocabulary and exit codes as JSON.

output: Human-readable text by default; --json where offered. The session file is JSONL, one object per line, every line carrying ts and type.
notes: Two contracts the tool will not bend. (1) A UXR marker is evidence for a pattern, never a verdict on a beat: below three occurrences the report shows individual moments with beat numbers and refuses to state a rate. (2) Ambiguity produces silence, not an accusation: every check requires positive evidence, so GM silence alone is never a finding. No composite score is produced anywhere, by design.

exit_codes.2: refused — bad input or not enough data

related.dmcheck: table conduct; reads this kit's session file directly
